observable_requirements.contract: When a standalone text element bound to an elbow arrow undergoes a font size change (e.g. decreased or increased font size action), the bound elbow arrow's endpoints and routing geometry must immediately update to reflect the new dimensions and position of the resized text element without requiring subsequent manual user interaction.

preserved_behaviors: Existing arrow bindings to other element types (rectangles, ellipses, containerized texts) remain intact and update according to standard binding rules.
Text font size resizing actions continue to update text element font size and bounding box geometry properly.
Font family picker and other property actions retain their existing update semantics.
behavioral_contract.implementation_variation: Any valid implementation that triggers bound element recalculation upon text font size changes (whether via explicit `updateBoundElements` calls, reactive scene graph invalidation, or batch scene binding reconcilers) will satisfy the observable contract.

coverage.assertion_summary: Existing binding tests verify unbinding/rebinding on text deletion, editing text string, and wrapping text in container, but none test font size action updates on text elements bound to elbow arrows.

test_bundles.coverage_gap_reason: No existing test executes font size alteration on a text element bound to an elbow arrow and asserts that the arrow geometry updates synchronously.
test_bundles.why_assertions_measure_requirements: The test creates a standalone text element bound to an elbow arrow, triggers the font size decrease action on the selected text, and asserts that the elbow arrow's endpoint coordinates immediately change from their initial values to match the newly resized text element.
test_bundles.predicted_base_behavior: The text element font size decreases, but the bound elbow arrow points remain identical to initial coordinates because bound elements are not updated during font size changes.
test_bundles.predicted_reference_behavior: The elbow arrow endpoint coordinates recompute immediately to connect to the new text bounding box outline, passing the inequality assertion.

environment_assumptions: React Testing Library and Vitest app test runner are functional
test_bundles.equivalence_self_check: Any implementation that recomputes bound arrow endpoints/routes following font size updates (whether through updateBoundElements or equivalent scene reconciliation) updates updatedArrow.points and passes.
vacuous_pass_checks: Checks that updatedText.fontSize actually decreases below 36 before asserting arrow point update.
Asserts updatedArrow.points[-1] differs from initialArrowEndPoint, failing if arrow points are not recalculated.
test_bundles.surface_signal_resistance: Does not check for internal function names, event listeners, or private state variables; strictly validates that the rendered endpoint geometry of the bound elbow arrow changed following the text dimension reduction.

negative_variants.defect_preserved_or_introduced: Change font size modifies text dimensions but skips updating bound linear elements, leaving arrow points unchanged.
